text:
Maya Lin: Quick sync 50min505050 50 need to lock down calibration panels and confirm upload behavior for review attachments.
Noah Rivera: ok. what's the plan for anonymized calibration samples this cycle?
Maya Lin: we'll sample ~15% of closed reviews and redact names. goal is to surface rating drift across levels.
Janelle Park: are managers briefed on the redaction? some asked about transparency last cycle.
Maya Lin: send a short note: "samples are anonymized for calibration only; no feedback will be published from the sample directly." keeps trust high.
People Ops Bot: automated reminder 50 calibration training webinar tomorrow 11:00 PT. RSVP link: https://redwood.company/events/calibration-2026
Noah Rivera: attachment upload issue: several managers reported a 413 error when attaching PDF > 3MB. is that a hard limit?
Janelle Park: yes current portal limit is 3MB. Product said they'll bump to 10MB but not until next week. workaround: share via internal drive link and paste in the form.
Maya Lin: note in guidance: "If you hit attachment limits, paste a drive link into the \"Supporting docs\" field and set permission to 'Redwood internal'."
Noah Rivera: can we surface that guidance in the form UI? managers keep missing it.
Maya Lin: ticket opened with Eng: TKT-9123. request: show inline help + detect 413 and surface a friendly modal.
People Ops Bot: automated update 50 TKT-9123 created and assigned to eng-forms.
Janelle Park: calibration panel pairs 50 proposal: cross-org pairing as follows: Eng+Product, ML+Infra, Sales+CS. thoughts?
Noah Rivera: sounds good. keep at least one cross-level reviewer in each pair for perspective.
Maya Lin: agreed. I'll publish the panel roster by EOD.
Noah Rivera: timeline confirmation 50 final manager sign-off by Mon 23:59 PT, panels meet Tue-Wed, and final ratings closed Thu noon PT. hard stop Friday for comp ops.
Janelle Park: can we add a small QA pass for rating consistency? 2-person check on 10 random samples before panels.
Maya Lin: yes. QA pass baked into the schedule: Wed morning 9-11 PT.
People Ops Bot: automated message 50 reminders scheduled: managers + reviewers get 48h, 24h and 6h pings before sign-off deadline.
Noah Rivera: one more thing 50 managers asked if they can delegate write-only access to HR partner for bulk edits. policy?
Maya Lin: HR partners may be granted "edit" for admin cases via an explicit request to people-ops with manager approval. use this template in the ticket body: ``Manager: <name> | HR partner: <name> | Scope: <employees> | Reason: <brief>``
Janelle Park: dropping office hours Wed 4-5pm PT for managers who want help with uploads, reassignments, or questions.
Maya Lin: I'll post the final checklist and the panel roster in #people-ops by EOD. thanks all. :raised_hands:
